assertions.assertion: The patient presents with a history of recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent syncope, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia.
The patient has a history of recurrent episodes of palpitations.
The patient has a history of intermittent syncope.
The patient's presentation raises concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia.
The diagnosis code I47.1 is assigned for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia.
A cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) is medically necessary for ambulatory evaluation.
The cardiac event monitoring study was explicitly ordered to address the patient's recurrent palpitations and intermittent syncope.
The patient's recurrent palpitations are associated with the diagnosis code R55.
The patient's intermittent syncope is associated with the diagnosis code R55.
